decisions.statement: A watched readout states the folders it reads and the files there it is made from.
The folders the watched readouts read are watched once rather than once each.
A file below a folder a readout reads is no file that readout is made from.
A readout read from a file beside its page is taken again when that file changes.
A moved file is answered by the readouts it is made from and by no other.
One take of every watched readout is made when the watch opens.
The moment a take is asked for is the moment its reading is kept under.
A take finding the value the take before found writes nothing and carries nothing.
A take finding no reading writes nothing and carries nothing.
A reading is kept beside the readout that reading was taken for.
A reading is carried to every site the watched readout names.
How fast a reading falls with the clock is read back off the readout and carried.
The rate carried is the one the take wrote rather than one worked out here.
A carry that fails to one site does not stop the carry to another site.
A carry that fails is said rather than ending the run.
Nothing is carried where no relay secret is stated.
Two takes of one readout never run at once.
Any number of changes arriving while a take runs make one further take.
A take of one readout runs while a take of another readout runs.
A take that throws is said.
A take that throws ends the run once the takes beside it settle.
A take that throws costs its own reading rather than the readings beside it.
The run ends at the grace where the takes beside a thrown take have not settled.
The first take to throw is the one the ending is handed.
A round of takes that all settled leaves the watch saying the round landed.
A round in which any take threw leaves the watch saying nothing.
The readouts that answered nothing are named with the round that landed.
A readout whose last take answered a number is not among them.
A readout the watch has taken no time yet is among them.
Saying a round landed that itself throws is said rather than ending the run.
Every watched readout is taken again on being asked rather than on a beat here.
A folder that cannot be followed is said and the rest are followed.
Nothing here works out which folders a readout reads.
Nothing here reads a reading out of a file.
Nothing here waits on a beat.
Nothing here writes what a round that landed leaves published.
Nothing here judges how long a readout may answer nothing.
Nothing here decides a reading held is too old to show.
Nothing here follows an index.

definition: the readings taken again as the files those readings are read from change
